backgrounds.name: the flow
backgrounds.description: Space round three black holes of one solar mass each, at the corners of a triangle 1 AU across, flowing as a potential flow: its speed from the three potentials added, sqrt(2GM/d1 + 2GM/d2 + 2GM/d3), and no swirl, running down the paths of things falling from rest far away. The grey arrows are the flow u, the dark ones g, its acceleration, which is Newton's gravity. Each hole has a region of its own; the dashed lines are the three seams where the regions meet, meeting at the centre, where g is zero.

layers.label: the seam, where the bodies' regions of flow meet
